result.question: Customer 3957 asks when order 30269 will arrive. What do we tell them?
result.answer: To answer when order 30269 will arrive, we need to check the order status. If the order is `shipped`, the delivery time depends on the carrier and destination. For standard shipping within the US, delivery typically takes 3-5 business days. For international orders, delivery may take 5-8 business days to Canada and 7-14 business days to the UK, Germany, Australia, and Indonesia. If the order is `pending`, it has not been processed yet and will ship once payment is confirmed. If the order is `delivered`, the item has already been received. For precise tracking, the customer can use the tracking link provided after the order ships, which is available under *Account → Orders*.
